question: In which of the following cities was the regional meeting with Waqf Boards held in October 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengaluru**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The regional meeting with **Waqf Boards** was organized in the city of **Bengaluru** in **October 2025** to discuss administrative reforms and the protection of **Waqf properties**.
 
• This high-level meeting was primarily focused on the **Southern States** and **Union Territories**, including **Karnataka**, **Kerala**, **Tamil Nadu**, **Andhra Pradesh**, **Telangana**, and **Puducherry**.
 
• The session was presided over by the **Union Minister of Minority Affairs**, who emphasized the importance of **transparency** and **accountability** in the management of community assets.
 
• A primary agenda of the **Bengaluru** conference was the review of the **digitization** process of **Waqf records** to prevent illegal encroachments and ensure better land **survey** accuracy.
